items: Feature
Eligibility
Salaried employees in EP-covered establishments; mandatory for many-sector workers.
Any resident individual can open an account.
Indian citizens aged 18-70; both salaried and self-employed can join.
Contribution rules
Lock-in / Tenure
Withdrawals
Tax treatment
Lockin / Tenure
EPF
Employee contributes 2% of basic + dearness allowance; employer also contributes.
15 years initial lock-in; extendable in 5-year blocks.
Partial withdrawals allowed for specified needs; full withdrawal is tax-favoured after 5 years of continuous
Contributions may qualify for deduction under Section 80C; interest and eligible withdrawals are generally tax-free, but interest on employee contribution above 2.5 lakh/year can be taxable.
PPF
₹50 minimum per year; ₹1.5 lakh maximum per financial year
Partial withdrawal allowed from the 7th year; premature closure after 5 years and for specified reasons
Contributions qualify under 80C; interest and maturity are generally fully tax-free.
NPS
₹1,0,no upper limit
Locked until age 6 for normal exit
Partial withdrawal allowed after 3 years, generally up to 5% of contributions for specified purposes
